name: Your Company
tagline: Boxing and combat sports for first-timers and for those who step into the ring

seo.title: Your Company — boxing and kickboxing club in Tashkent
seo.description: Boxing, kickboxing and conditioning for adults and teens. Beginner groups, personal training, and your first session is free.
seo.answer: Your Company is a boxing and kickboxing club at 54 Bobur St, Tashkent. A pass for 8 group sessions costs 550,000 UZS, unlimited is 890,000 UZS a month, a personal session 250,000 UZS. Your first session is free and we lend gloves. Open Mon–Sat 7:00–22:00, Sun 9:00–15:00.

listing.description: A site for a boxing club, martial arts school or fitness studio. A fight-poster hero with huge type and a round timer, programmes as outlined rows, coaches by ring corner and memberships behind the ropes.

sections.title: Boxing without fear
sections.subtitle: We teach you to punch properly and not to fear a punch. Beginner groups with no sparring in the first month, personal training and preparation for amateur bouts.

sections.label: The club
sections.title: A ring, twenty bags and coaches who explain
sections.text: Your Company is 600 m² in a basement on Bobur St: a full-size ring, twenty heavy bags, a conditioning area and changing rooms with showers. Our coaches fought for the national team and started from zero themselves, so they show rather than shout. Students, developers, new mums and people preparing for a bout all train here.

sections.label: Programmes
sections.title: Choose your corner
sections.intro: All groups are capped at 12. Prices are per drop-in session; passes work out cheaper.

items.title: Boxing
items.text: Stance, punches, defence and partner drills. Sparring is optional and never before month two.

items.title: Kickboxing
items.text: Hands and kicks, combinations, pads and bags. Great for conditioning and coordination.

items.title: Conditioning
items.text: Boxer circuits: skipping, battle ropes, medicine ball and stamina work.

items.title: Teens
items.text: Ages 12–16. Technique, discipline and safety, no hard sparring.

items.title: One-to-one
items.text: An hour alone with a coach: your goal, a plan and every mistake explained.

items.label: of gym floor on Bobur St

items.title: Trial
items.text: A free session in the beginners’ group. We lend gloves and wraps.

items.title: Stance
items.text: Month one is all technique and stamina, no sparring.

items.title: Combos
items.text: Pad work with a coach, combinations and defence.

items.title: The ring
items.text: Light sparring in headgear, when you feel ready.

items.name: Personal
features: A plan built around your goal

items.quote: I came to lose weight and stayed for the boxing. Six months in, I did my first sparring round.
items.author: Nodira

items.quote: Nobody hit me in the first month, it was all technique. That’s what won me over.
items.author: Timur

items.quote: My son has been in the teen group for a year. More discipline, fewer fights.
items.author: Alisher

items.q: Can I come with no experience?
items.a: Yes, most people start from zero. The beginners’ group is steady and the coach adjusts the load.

sections.label: Book
sections.title: Round one is on us
sections.text: Tell us on Telegram when suits you and we’ll book you into a beginners’ group. Arrive 15 minutes early and we’ll show you around.
